lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the fifth branchial slit, a series of high-luminance circular spot centroids are visible, arranged in three primary vertical columns. The central column contains four prominent, equidistant circular maxima situated between the dorsal ridge and the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, forming a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral), extending from the supra-branchial region posteriorly.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of small, high-frequency white pixels is concentrated on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin, distinct from the larger, more sparse spot pattern on the main flank.
